# Siemens Washing Machine Repair Mumbai

> Independent Siemens washing machine repair service in Mumbai. Same-day service, genuine spare parts, experienced technicians, and 1+ year warranty on installed parts.

We are an independent repair service (not an official Siemens service centre) specialising in Siemens washing machines across Mumbai and its suburbs. We also repair all other major washing machine brands, including Samsung, LG, IFB, Bosch, Whirlpool, Godrej, Haier, Panasonic, Onida and Videocon.

Contact: +91 98338 75771 · WhatsApp: https://wa.me/919833875771
Service hours: 9 AM – 9 PM, every day.

## Brands we repair

- [Samsung washing machine repair](/brands/samsung-washing-machine-repair-mumbai): Samsung front-load and top-load repair across Mumbai.
- [LG washing machine repair](/brands/lg-washing-machine-repair-mumbai): LG Direct Drive front-load and top-load repair across Mumbai.
- [IFB washing machine repair](/brands/ifb-washing-machine-repair-mumbai): IFB front-load and top-load repair across Mumbai.
- [Bosch washing machine repair](/brands/bosch-washing-machine-repair-mumbai): Bosch repair across Mumbai (Bosch and Siemens share the same manufacturer, BSH Hausgeräte, and a similar error-code system).
